tasks.AnswerChoicesVerification: Verify which answer choice matches the calculated new average.
tasks.CalculateNewAverage: Calculate the new average excluding the highest and lowest scorers.
tasks.CalculateSumOfAllScores: Calculate the total sum of all scores in the class using the overall average score.
tasks.DefineVariables: Define the variables for the highest score (H), lowest score (L), average of class scores (Y), number of students in the class (Z).
tasks.SetEquationsForExtremes: Set up equations based on given information regarding the highest and lowest scores.
tasks.SubtractExtremeScores: Subtract the highest and lowest scores from the total sum to get the adjusted sum.
